assessor: Root Codex AI agent /root, case-author-side primary assessment
method: Primary educational scores recorded with neutral IDs and full accepted input, before consulting independent agent scores or any tested review verdict. Existing protocol/provider knowledge and recognizable scenarios prevent full blinding.

checks.rationale: Targets the observed unsupported climate inference, checks supplied values and limits, and uses one bounded changed-pattern check. No archive fetching or invented exam weights.
checks.stoppingGate: Stop on independent defensible interpretation, missing evidence and transfer check.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.
minorNotes: The reference to comparisons across stations overstates what is necessary for a local long-term trend; the decisive missing multi-year evidence is correct.

checks.rationale: Preserves the recording/editing/speaker-checking scope but books only a consent-aware outline, with all four brief checks. Brief modeling could be more concrete, without requiring a literal interview script.
checks.stoppingGate: Checked concrete-event question outline containing permission, open question, follow-up and correction opportunity.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.

checks.rationale: All three categories are practiced and independently checked, but the strategy credits inferential reading as already partly performed without supplied learner evidence for that ability. Unknown weights remain honestly disclosed.
checks.stoppingGate: Independent classification and justification across two unseen passages, not timer attendance.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.

defects.acceptedExcerpt: The learner can find a direct quotation but treats plausible background stories as established facts.
defects.outputExcerpt: Inference practice focuses on the evidence-to-conclusion link already partly performed.
defects.additionalOutputExcerpt: Evidence shows literal quotation is already partly secure, inferential reading is demonstrated in the sample passage
defects.consequence: The supplied classification examples are credited as partly demonstrated learner ability, supporting reduced inference emphasis without actual performance evidence. The credit needs correction or an initial diagnostic; final all-category checks prevent this from being a serious omission of the outcome.

checks.rationale: Correctly distinguishes valid implication from converse and requires unfamiliar independent decisions with counterexamples or truth conditions. Formal proof notation and a fixed quota are not required.
checks.stoppingGate: Independent decision and bounded justification on fresh items; revisited retention check remains informative.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.
minorNotes: No formal assessment exists is stronger than not supplied, but no assessment weight, readiness or essential resource is invented.

checks.rationale: The strategy retains future scope and the actual description, but applies a mandatory image-alt attribute check even on the explicitly allowed text-placeholder route; this narrows the accepted checkpoint without support.
checks.stoppingGate: Independent local card rebuild and alt explanation, but the stated attribute gate excludes an allowed text placeholder.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.
minorNotes: Unaided rebuild without copying is a stricter demonstration than the stated first-card outcome; treat it as a proportion/clarity concern rather than a separate serious blocker.

defects.acceptedExcerpt: No object image file is supplied. The first card may use a text placeholder and explain the alternative text that an actual image would need.
defects.outputExcerpt: alt attribute is present and descriptive, not empty or decorative
defects.additionalOutputExcerpt: an image element — or an explicit placeholder — carrying a meaningful alt attribute
defects.consequence: A readable heading/description card using the allowed text placeholder and explanation can meet every accepted requirement yet fail the mandatory alt-attribute gate. A text placeholder is not an image element with an alt attribute. The strategy needs conditional checks for the two permitted routes instead of an image requirement on both.

checks.rationale: Uses only the occupation/current-tiredness distinction, changed production and explanation, conditional bounded correction and honest unknown retention. No claimed readiness from self-report.
checks.stoppingGate: Novel correct production for both uses, explanations and a bounded transfer item; stop after a failed correction rather than drill.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.
minorNotes: Different pronouns should stay within supplied es/está forms; the explicit opening scope restriction permits that reading, so do not invent a compulsory conjugation expansion.
Several novel sentences and one transfer item are a modest bounded check, not evidence of a serious fixed quota.

checks.rationale: Correctly totals all real bars at four, addresses the two-eighths misconception and stops after actual worksheet explanation/checking. Modalities are alternatives; no recording, new bars or broad mastery claim.
checks.stoppingGate: All three assigned bars explained and checked as four; single error-triggered recount.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.

checks.rationale: Keeps all four actual annotation requirements and correct observation/interpretation distinction, checks literal quotes and a specific source limit, with no essay or extra sources.
checks.stoppingGate: All four annotation requirements, matching quote and author-view wording rather than universal opinion count.
checks.resources: Accepted supplied material; no external resource requirement except the disputed image gate in A05.

summary.adjudication: Required before final failure verdicts; preserve independent assessment and disagreements without averaging.
